robot_walk:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent PNG sprite sheet for real frame-by-frame animation, eight distinct poses
Primary request: An original cute small rounded blue-and-cream robot walking in place, strict side view facing right. Eight successive walk-cycle frames, in reading order left-to-right top-to-bottom. Frame 1 right foot ahead and left foot behind; frame 2 lowered body and bent front knee; frame 3 passing pose one foot flat below body and the rear leg passing forward; frame 4 raised body, swinging knee forward; frame 5 opposite contact left foot ahead and right behind; frame 6 lower body with other knee bent; frame 7 opposite passing pose; frame 8 raised body with opposite knee forward. Arms alternate naturally, exactly two arms and two legs throughout.
Style/medium: polished 2D game sprite, crisp clean solid outlines, soft pastel color shading, readable compact silhouette. Entirely original friendly design, circular head, small antenna, cream faceplate with one visible dark eye in side view, blue torso, cream hands and feet. No logo.
Composition/framing: one wide 2:1 landscape image divided into exactly 4 equal columns and 2 equal rows, eight square cells, no visible cell boundaries. In each cell character stays centered on same horizontal position, same pixel scale, same side-on view and shared ground baseline. Character comfortably contained in each cell with generous 15% transparent margins. Every cell contains exactly one complete full-body robot. The eight characters must be the SAME robot, with same dimensions, antenna, and colors. Intentional small vertical walk bounce only; no camera motion, no left-to-right travel.
Scene/backdrop: actual transparent background and all gutters fully transparent, no shadows on ground.
Constraints: exactly eight full-body distinct walk poses, one per equal square cell, row-major order. PNG with alpha. No letters, captions, numbers, labels, grid lines, borders, scenery, props, motion streaks, separate shadows or watermark. Do not place any pixels outside the eight cell-safe regions.
mascot_expressions:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent PNG sprite sheet, eight original expression-animation frames
Primary request: An original friendly round peach-orange mochi mascot with tiny rounded ears, small dark oval eyes, little curved mouth, two small feet and two small arms. The mascot stays sitting still in front view while its face changes through eight clear successive states: 1 calm face with open eyes and tiny closed smile; 2 half-closed eyes starting a blink; 3 fully closed eyes for blink; 4 eyes reopen; 5 mouth begins a warm smile, cheeks gently raised; 6 big joyful open smile, raised cheeks and happy curved eyes; 7 smaller closed smile as eyes reopen; 8 back to the same calm face as frame 1. Keep ears, round body, feet, arms, silhouette and size unchanged in all frames. No arm or body movement, facial expression only.
Style/medium: polished cute 2D game sprite, clean solid dark orange outlines, softly shaded peach-colored body, no texture noise, compact rounded silhouette. Entirely original character, no franchise likeness.
Composition/framing: one wide 2:1 landscape image laid out in exactly 4 equal columns and 2 equal rows, eight square cells with no visible boundaries. Exactly one complete front-view mascot centered in each cell, identical scale and canvas anchor throughout, eyes and mouth at same facial position. Character fits safely inside each cell with generous 18% fully transparent margins on every side.
Scene/backdrop: actual transparent background, transparent gutters, no ground or shadows.
Constraints: eight clearly distinguishable facial states in row-major animation order, positions constant, identity perfectly consistent, all body parts fully visible. No words, letters, labels, numbers, borders, grid lines, objects, confetti, speech bubbles, watermark, or extra faces.
flag_wave:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent PNG sprite sheet, eight frames of one waving flag
Primary request: Eight successive animation phases of a single plain unbranded teal cloth flag waving gently in a breeze, attached to one slim warm-gray vertical pole with a tiny round top finial. The pole is stationary at identical position and height in every frame. The flag is attached on the pole's right side, has a rectangular cloth shape with a free trailing right edge, and each phase shows a distinct smooth S-wave fold traveling from the fixed left edge to the free right edge. Frames progress continuously through one full wave cycle: 0,45,90,135,180,225,270,315 degrees. Different visible crest and trough shapes throughout, not merely moving the whole flag. Smooth return from frame8 to frame1.
Style/medium: polished simple 2D game sprite illustration, crisp dark-teal outline, restrained soft teal cloth shading following the folds. Minimal, readable at 128px. No emblems, no lettering, no country insignia.
Composition/framing: wide 2:1 landscape PNG divided into exactly 4 equal columns and 2 equal rows, eight square cells, invisible boundaries. In every square cell one full flag and full pole, the pole aligned at 27% cell width, top finial at 17% cell height, pole bottom at 87% cell height, rightmost flag edge safely within 87% cell width. Exactly same pole and cloth size and same camera view in all cells. Fixed pole base anchor. Flag starts beneath finial and occupies the upper half of the pole, leaving lower pole visible.
Scene/backdrop: actual transparent background and gutters, no ground shadow or floor.
Constraints: exactly eight complete flags, row-major order, one full anchored flag per equal cell, 15% empty transparent margins, no clipping or overlap, no decorations, text, numbers, borders, grid lines, extra flags, smoke, clouds, wind streaks, or watermark.
